content: Uca inna Netta i Musa: “Geɛɛed ɣar SIDI, cek d Harun d Nadab d Abihu, d sebɛin n imɣaren n Israil, uca bendqem zi řaggʷaj.
Musa weḥḥdes ad dd-iqarreb ɣar SIDI, maca war iɛeddeř ad qarrben nitni. Uřa d řgens war kides ittgiɛɛid ca.”
Musa iɛqeb-dd uca ixebbar řgens x marra awařen n SIDI u x marra lfarayiḍ. Marra řgens yarra-dd s yijj n wawař, nnan: “Marra awařen i inna SIDI ad zzaysen negg.”
Musa yura marra awařen n SIDI. Ɣar ṣṣbeḥ zic ikkar uca ibna ijj n uɛalṭar ɣar iḍaren n wedrar uca igga tenɛac n imayḍuten n weẓru, ɛlaḥsab řqedd n tenɛac n tqebbař n Israil.
Issekk iḥudriyyen zeg ayt n Israil, inni issbexxaren tiɣarṣi n wecmaḍ u qeddmen tiɣarṣi n řehna zeg ifunasen imeẓyanen i SIDI.
Iksi Musa azyen n idammen, igga i-t di ṭṭbaṣi uca azyen nneɣni n idammen izeǧeɛ i-ten x uɛalṭar.
Iksi adlis ittwannḍen n Řɛahd, iɣra i-t x imezzuɣen n řgens uca nitni nnan: “Marra min d aneɣ inna SIDI, ad t negg, ad t nṭaɛ.”
Iksi Musa idammen, irucc i-ten x řgens, inna: “Xzar, ina d idammen n Řɛahd nni igga SIDI akidwem x marra awařen-a.”
Igeɛɛed Musa ak-d Harun d Nadab d Abihu d sebɛin n imɣaren n Israil.
Ẓrin AREBBI n Israil. Tuɣa sadu iḍaren nnes am tisi n zzellij i ittwaggen n ṣaffir aziza, iṣfa am ujenna simant nnes.
War isswiẓẓeḍ afus nnes x imcennɛen n ayt n Israil uca nitni xzaren ɣar AREBBI, ccin, swin.
Inna SIDI i Musa: “Geɛɛed-dd ɣari ɣar wedrar uca qqim din uca Necc ad ac wceɣ tiřwiḥin n weẓru, Ccariɛa d řumarat tinni uriɣ x teřwiḥin, ḥima ad asen tent tessřemded.”
Ikkar Musa ak-d Yacuwa, amsexxar nnes, uca igeɛɛed Musa ɣar wedrar n AREBBI.
Inna i imɣaren: “Rajam aneɣ danita ař dd ɣarwem i ɣa nedweř. Xzar, Harun d Ḥur akidwem. Mařa din ḥed ɣares ddɛawi, ittxeṣṣa as ad ɣarsen iraḥ.”
Xenni igeɛɛed Musa ɣar wedrar, uca ijj n useynu idřa adrar.
Aɛuǧi n SIDI tuɣa izeddeɣ deg wedrar n Sina u aseynu idřa i-t setta n wussan uca deg wass wiss sebɛa iřaɣa-dd Netta x Musa zi řwesṭ n useynu.
Ascan n uɛuǧi n SIDI tuɣa-t di tiṭṭawin n ayt n Israil am tmessi ittetten x tqiccat n wedrar.
Yudef Musa ɣar řwesṭ n useynu uca igeɛɛed adrar. Tuɣa Musa iqqim arebɛin n wussan d arebɛin n ǧyaři deg wedrar.

footnotes.text: s yijj n wawař- s Tɛibranit ‘s yijj n uqemmum’.
